name: What are common mistakes to avoid in accessible bathroom design?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid in accessible bathroom design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include not planning for future needs, insufficient maneuvering space, improper grab bar placement, choosing slippery flooring materials, and ignoring adequate lighting. Another frequent oversight is not ensuring wide enough doorways or clear pathways. It's crucial to consider the specific needs of the user and consult with experienced professionals to avoid these issues and ensure a truly functional and safe space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid insufficient space, improper grab bar placement, slippery floors, inadequate lighting, and narrow doorways to ensure true accessibility.
